Welcome to 42-78 65 Place Apartments — where modern comfort meets convenience! Enjoy stylish apartments featuring air conditioning, high-end finishes and appliances, in-unit washer and dryer, and private patio or balcony options. Residents can also enjoy a gym and rooftop terrace, elevator, security cameras, and convenient access to public transportation. Pet-friendly — small pets up to 8 lbs.  Requires a $300 deposit.
Tenant is responsible for electricity including stove, heat (split unit), and hot water.

rentals.lotteryDescription: Many residents already call Cantilever House home and enjoy the comfort and convenience of this vibrant community. Now, just three beautifully designed one-bedroom units remain available at 21 Garden Street, located at the crossroads of Williamsburg and Bushwick. Each home features an open layout with a charming kitchen and bathroom, offering an inviting place to live. Residents enjoy a full-service package room*, lounge with co-working and media spaces, and a state-of-the-art fitness center* with dedicated areas for yoga*, cardio*, and more. The landscaped rooftop deck* provides a relaxing outdoor space, while bike storage* and indoor parking* offer added convenience. With modern amenities, thoughtful design, and a prime Brooklyn location, Cantilever House offers comfortable urban living in a neighborhood full of energy and character. Pet-friendly (max 2, 30 lbs. each, non-aggressive breeds). Tenants are responsible for electricity, including electric stove, hot water, and heat.

Discover One River Park, where modern living is at its peak. Experience the serenity and relaxation of living alongside the Harlem River. Located at 355 Exterior Street, Bronx, NY 10451, in the vibrant Mott Haven neighborhood, this 40-story building features 29 studios, 154 one-bedroom, and 44 two-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts and modern designs. Residents can enjoy exceptional amenities, including a Lobby Lounge, Sky Lobby, Bike Storage, Storage Lockers, Package Room, Fitness Center, Pet Spa, Yoga Studio, Spin Studio, Game Room, Golf Simulator, Movie Theater, Indoor Pickleball Court, Party Room, Kids Room, Outdoor Pool, Rooftop Terraces with Grill Stations, and more. One River Park offers quality city living at affordable rents.
One pet allowed with a 30 lb. weight limit per pet; additional restrictions apply. No pet deposit required. Tenants are responsible for electricity, including electric stove and electric heat. Hot water is included in the rent.

rentals.lotteryDescription:
Domi offers 57 affordable units at 29-24 40th Avenue, where contemporary design and city living comes together at an affordable price! Near transportation, shopping, dining, and entertainment, Domi puts convenience and style within reach.

Apartment features include private balconies, dishwashers, washers and dryers. Building conveniences include common area Wi-Fi, an elevator, satellite TV, doorman, on-site resident manager, and online payment options.

Residents may enjoy an optional $95/month amenity package per household, including a landscaped courtyard*, rooftop lounge*, fitness and yoga center*, music and podcast room*, co-working lounge*, game room*, dining/bar lounge and event space*, and dog washing station*.

Up to two pets per household are welcome, each up to 50 lbs., with no pet security deposit. Aggressive breeds are prohibited. Service animals are always welcome.

Tenants are responsible for electricity, including cooking, and heating. Hot water is included in the rent.

rentals.lotteryDescription:
1 Gouverneur Lane is the most anticipated lottery of the year, located in the heart of Downtown Manhattan. Residential interiors are designed for comfort and purpose, offering a sleek and stylish way to entertain, gather, and live. 

Service/Support animals are allowed a maximum of 2 Pets of any kind. The Pet, or two Pets may not weigh no more than 50 pounds combined at full maturity. No dogs of the Rottweiler, Doberman, Pitbull, German Shepherd variety, mixed or pedigreed with an aggressive nature as determined by Owner in its discretion will be permitted without written consent. There will be no cat breeds with an aggressive nature, or caged birds permitted in an Apartment without the express written consent of the Owner’s agent. No fish tanks are permitted in the building.

Tenant responsible for electricity including stove. Rent includes water, gas and heat.
